fusions.name: Lunge Feeding
fusions.desc: You surge up through the shoal around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Darting Silver
fusions.desc: Sends a darting fish that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then slips to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Its reach is 40% longer. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Among the Silver
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds, moving 10% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Slips the Jaws
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that would land on you is rolled again, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
